transformations: Published first-round results transcribed from linked reports/articles; metadata inheritance is explicit. Original runoff fields and stable legacy IDs retained.
No PNAD, bias correction, imputation, valid-vote rescaling or prediction. Descriptive trailing 7-day averages are computed separately for charts.
The browser loads data/raw-polls.json with no-store semantics and falls back to the bundled module only when the runtime feed is unavailable.
limitations: 95 first-round waves matched to 95 runoff waves; one representative stimulated scenario per wave. Candidate/category coverage remains partial in some releases; alternative scenarios are not fully transcribed.
Runoff records inherit existing Observer provenance and source reconciliation notes; not all 95 source reports were independently re-audited.
First-round scenarios have different tested candidate lists. Missing candidate values remain missing.
Published margins are survey-wide maxima, not candidate-specific model intervals.
Market files preserve provider timestamps. Browser refresh is automatic; the owned Hostinger scheduler must keep the public artifact current.
